standard.summary: 控制训练过程中生成预览图使用的采样器（如 euler / euler_a / dpm++ 等）和生成参数（步数、分辨率、种子）。
standard.effect: euler/euler_a 速度快（适合预览）；dpm++ 质量更高（需要更多步数）。sample_steps 通常设 15~25（快速预览），不需要像推理时那么多步。
standard.whenToUse: euler 配合 15~20 步是最快的预览方案，足以判断 LoRA 训练方向是否正确。
standard.avoidWhen: 预览不需要使用最高质量采样器，避免浪费训练时间（生成预览会暂停训练）。

optionDescriptions.ddim: DDIM，步数少也还行，预览常拿来用。
optionDescriptions.lms: LMS，多步线性，味道跟 Euler 不太一样。
optionDescriptions.euler_a: Euler Ancestral，带点随机，图会「活」一点，不好完全复现。
optionDescriptions.heun: Heun，二阶，往往比 Euler 细一点，也更贵。
optionDescriptions.dpmsolver++: DPM-Solver++，少步出图质量一般不错。

standard_en.summary: Controls the sampler used to generate preview images during training (euler / euler_a / dpm++ and so on) and the generation parameters (steps, resolution, seed).
standard_en.effect: euler/euler_a are fast (good for previews); dpm++ gives higher quality (and needs more steps). sample_steps is usually 15~25 for a quick preview, without needing as many steps as inference.
standard_en.whenToUse: euler with 15~20 steps is the fastest preview setup and is enough to judge whether the LoRA is heading in the right direction.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A preview does not need the highest-quality sampler; avoid wasting training time (generating a preview pauses training).

optionDescriptions.ddim: DDIM: decent even at a low step count, and often used for previews.
optionDescriptions.lms: LMS, multi-step linear, with a different flavour from Euler.
optionDescriptions.euler_a: Euler Ancestral: a touch of randomness makes the image livelier, and it cannot be reproduced exactly.
optionDescriptions.heun: Heun, second order, usually a little finer than Euler and more expensive too.
optionDescriptions.dpmsolver++: DPM-Solver++: usually good quality at a low step count.

advanced.principle: 预览生成使用与推理相同的采样器逻辑，但步数更少。sample_smoothcache_error_threshold 控制本仓 lulynx 误差缓存的复用阈值；它不是 SmoothCache 论文的 calibration schedule。sample_seed 固定后每次预览使用相同种子，方便对比不同步数的变化。
advanced.tradeoffs: sample_width/height 应与 resolution 匹配，分辨率不匹配时预览效果可能误导（预览清晰但实际生成不同分辨率时效果可能不同）。

advanced_en.principle: Preview generation uses the same sampler logic as inference, with fewer steps. sample_smoothcache_error_threshold controls this repo's lulynx error-cache reuse threshold; it is not the SmoothCache paper's calibration schedule. Once sample_seed is fixed, every preview uses the same seed, making it easy to compare changes across step counts.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: sample_width/height should match resolution; a mismatch can make previews misleading (a sharp preview may not translate when actual generation happens at a different resolution).
